reasoning: The icon depicts the standard camera UI toggle for 'Auto Flash' (a lightning bolt with the letter A). Because it represents a specific device setting/mode rather than a concrete object or common to-do subject, it is poor as a task icon except as a stand-in for a camera flash unit or electrical amperage.
